source_title: ARDOT Arkansas Highway Police — Permit Rules 2023 (Oversize/Overweight Vehicles)

superload_thresholds.note: Arkansas 'Super Loads of Extraordinary Weight or Dimension' (Permit Rules 2023, Rule 1.I) triggered when a load exceeds any of: 16'6" wide, 15'6" high, 100' overall length, or 180,000 lbs gross. The Department may require engineering examinations and advance application; structural review of Federal bridge formula and bridges reserved.

width.note: non-divided/2-lane: 1 front escort (no width escort on divided 4-lane until over 14')
divided 4-lane: 1 rear escort; non-divided/2-lane: 2 escorts (front + rear). Max width 20' general hwy, 18' Interstate

height.note: over 15': 1 front escort with clearance bar 6" above permitted height
over 17': written agreements/accompaniment from overhead-utility owners along the route

length.note: >=100' load length: 1 escort — rear on Interstate/controlled-access/divided 4+-lane, front (lead) on all other highways
over 115' on highways with fewer than 4 lanes: 2 escorts (lead + following)

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip oversize permit = $17 flat (ACA 27-35-210). Overweight = $17 base + tonnage-mileage chart per ton (or major fraction) over lawful weight: <=100 mi $8/ton; 101-150 mi $10; 151-200 mi $12; 201-250 mi $14; 251+ mi $16 (reduced chart for mobile construction equipment).
single_trip.note: Specific-unit permits valid 6 consecutive days, no extension. Surety bond min $1,000 for self-issue/account permits.

annual.note: Annual/long-term: $500/yr per vehicle; overlength combination <=57' single-trip or 1-yr $500; width <=10'8" cargo single-route from adjacent state <=15 mi into one county $1,000/yr.

movement_restrictions: Daylight movement only (per NWS sunrise-sunset) for oversize loads
Greater Little Rock rush-hour ban 7-9 a.m. and 4-6 p.m. on I-30 (MM 138-143), I-40 (MM 151-155), and all of I-630
No movement when visibility <500 ft or in inclement weather (hard rain, freezing rain, sleet, snow)
Movement may be restricted when winds/gusts exceed 20 knots (23 mph)
No movement on listed holidays; overall combination over 90' is daylight-only, no-holiday
Overweight-only loads (within legal dimensions) may move Saturday, Sunday, holidays and at night
Never stop traffic more than 3 minutes or within 500 ft of a hilltop (ACA 27-35-213)
notes: Legal width 8'6" (8'0" manufactured homes), height 14'0" (NOT 13'6"), semitrailer 53'6", gross 80,000 lbs on 5+ axles meeting the Federal Bridge Formula.
Permit axle maxima (Rule 4): single 20,000; tandem 46,000 (<=23,000/axle); tridem 60,000 (<=20,000/axle); quadrum 68,000 (<=17,000/axle). Federal Bridge Formula published in the rules.
All values (dimensions, escort matrix, superload thresholds, $17 single-trip fee, overweight tonnage chart, curfews) sourced from the ARDOT Permit Rules 2023 PDF.
State-level rules only — county/city permits, bridge-specific engineering and low-clearance routing are out of scope.
